name: ORION FA1

specs.notes: An original, fictional single-seater for FORMULA APEX (the game's own series: no real team, car or branding), its numbers modelled on 2022-25 Formula 1 rules: 800 kg with the driver and without fuel (the FIA's 2025 minimum, up from 798 kg), ~45 % on the front (McLaren's MCL39: 44.6-46.1 %), a 1.6 V6 turbo hybrid revving to 15,000 rpm by the rules (fuel flow capped at 100 kg/h from 10,500 rpm, so the power is flat above it), a 120 kW MGU-K deploying 4 MJ a lap and recovering 2 MJ, eight gears, Pirelli 18 in slicks 305 / 405 mm wide and 720 mm across (the model's: 700 mm). The engine's ~590 kW (the combustion engine alone; ~710 kW with the MGU-K), its torque curve, the ratios, aero (CdA and downforce: a lift coefficient ~3.6 on ~1.5 m2, as published estimates for post-2017 cars put it) and DRS's effect are estimates. The model: 4,980 x 2,040 mm, a 3,250 mm wheelbase (its own, used at its own size).

garage.blurb: A FORMULA APEX single-seater: 800 kg, a turbo hybrid V6 screaming to 12,500 and more grip than you'll believe at speed. The shorter of the two: it turns in like nothing else and bites at the rear when you're greedy.

interior.notes: An open cockpit under the halo: the model's monocoque and halo, a race wheel added (tools/cars/formula_halo.json), the driver reclined with the helmet in the air.

limitations: A low-poly model (3,200 body triangles, flat colours, no textures): it fits the game's flat-colour look, but is plainer up close than the scanned GT cars.
Power, torque, ratios, aero and DRS's effect are estimates (teams don't publish them); see specs.notes.
